##: Friendly monitor names -> stable hardware identity. DECLARED here, enforced by chezmoi.
WHY THIS EXISTS: \\.\DISPLAYn GDI names DRIFT. They are reassigned by driver resets,
GPU disable/enable, and display-config changes. On this machine they have already
walked to DISPLAY7/8/9, which silently broke evict-crt.ps1 (hardcoded DISPLAY3) and
killed the '[RC] Display: \\.\DISPLAY3' assignments on DOOM and The Dark Mod.
So nothing anywhere should name a monitor by its GDI name. Everything refers to the
friendly names below, and resolution goes: devicePath -> hardwareId -> resolution.
TO (RE)LABEL: focus the monitor you want to name, then run the Raycast command
It rewrites THIS file in the chezmoi source; commit it afterwards.
devicePath is the most stable id (physical panel + port). hardwareId is the EDID
vendor+product code and is stable per model but not unique if you own two of the same
panel. resolution is the last resort - it is the only usable handle for a monitor with
no EDID, which is exactly the CRT's situation ('Default_Monitor').

acer.note: Acer XG270HU - comms + music live here (workspaces 2, 3)

crt.note: CRT - no EDID, reports the useless hardwareId 'Default_Monitor', so match on resolution
